environment.description: Application deployed on EC2 instance (m5.large) behind an Application Load Balancer with default listener rules (forward all to target group). Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. ALB access logs enabled to S3 bucket. No additional managed rule groups attached. TLS 1.2 enforced via ALB security policy ELBSecurityPolicy-TLS-1-2-2017-01.
